description: Give the new page order (3,1,2), delete pages (4-6) or reverse the whole document; pages you leave out of the order are dropped. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/pdf-organize.

order.description: New order, e.g. 3,1,2 (pages left out are removed)
